title: 12 Best Day Trips from Tokyo
description: Discover the 12 best day trips from Tokyo in 2026! Explore Hakone, Kamakura, Nikko, and more. Find top destinations for culture, nature, and relaxation, perfect for a memorable escape from the city.

places.name: Hakone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take the Hakone Ropeway for breathtaking panoramic views of Mount Fuji and the volcanic Owakudani valley. Try the black eggs (kuro-tamago) cooked in the sulfurous hot springs there.

places.name: Kamakura
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Visit the Great Buddha of Kamakura and Hase-dera Temple with its stunning gardens and ocean views. Sample 'shirasu-don' (whitebait rice bowl), a local specialty.

places.name: Nikko
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the intricate carvings and vibrant colors of the Toshogu Shrine. Don't miss the Kegon Falls, one of Japan's most beautiful waterfalls, easily accessible by elevator.

places.name: Kawaguchiko (Fuji Five Lakes)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take the Kachi Kachi Ropeway for a stunning panoramic view of Lake Kawaguchiko and Mount Fuji. Visit Chureito Pagoda for the quintessential 'Fuji with pagoda' photo.

places.name: Yokohama
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore Yokohama Chinatown and sample various street foods like steamed buns (manju) or sesame balls. Take a stroll through the Red Brick Warehouse area for unique shops and cafes.

places.name: Enoshima Island
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Visit the Enoshima Shrine complex, dedicated to the goddess Benzaiten, and explore the Iwaya Caves at the island's far end. Try the fresh seafood, especially 'shirasu' (whitebait) dishes.

places.name: Mount Takao
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Hike up to the summit to visit Yakuoin Temple and enjoy the panoramic views. Try the local 'Takaosan soba' (buckwheat noodles) after your hike.

places.name: Kawagoe ("Little Edo")
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wander down Kashiya Yokocho (Candy Alley) and try traditional Japanese sweets. Don't miss the Toki no Kane (Bell of Time) and Kitain Temple with its famous 500 Rakan statues.

places.name: Odawara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore Odawara Castle and its surrounding park. Try 'kamaboko' (fish cakes), a local specialty, from one of the many shops around the castle.

places.name: Atami
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Relax at a public footbath or day-use onsen. Visit the MOA Museum of Art for its art collection and the incredible observation deck overlooking the city and ocean.

places.name: Karuizawa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Rent a bicycle to explore the picturesque Shiraito Falls and enjoy the town's lush surroundings. Indulge in some retail therapy at the Karuizawa Prince Shopping Plaza.

places.name: Nokogiriyama
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take the ropeway up and explore the Nihon-ji Temple grounds, including the colossal Daibutsu and the thrilling 'Hell Peek' observation deck.
